description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahadawa Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511800 (23/55014)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It includes detailed land descriptions, parcel numbers, extents of land, and procedures for registering title to properties of deceased individuals without wills. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns property ownership, land titles, and land registration processes.
